note: DRAFT ONLY: prepare matching toolchains, create Mac4 gate devices, replace REQUIRES_* values, then validate and gate the change. The Foundry gate's verifier (one-foundry tools/foundry-verify) runs these on the tree a merge would produce, with the binaries .foundry/assets.json lists restored by sha256, read from main so a proposal cannot change its own check. Each check runs only when a changed path matches its `when`. The two web checks type-check and run vitest against node_modules kept on the T7 per package-lock.json; an install that fails is exit 75: not judged, never a failed test. The iOS project wants apps/ios/Config/Local.xcconfig, which is gitignored, so the check copies Local.example.xcconfig into place: the unit tests reach no backend. It runs the unit tests only: the UI tests need the QA backend and its secrets, which the gate does not have. studio/ (but for print-config), apps/hydrogen-store and media/ have no check: a change confined to them merges unchecked.
name: serenity checks

checks.name: engine tsc + vitest (mac5)
command: export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; cd engine || exit 75; H=$(shasum -a 256 package-lock.json | cut -c1-12); N=/Volumes/FoundryBuild/fleet-dd/serenity-verify/engine-$H; if [ ! -d $N/node_modules ]; then rm -rf /Volumes/FoundryBuild/fleet-dd/serenity-verify/engine-*; mkdir -p $N && cp package.json package-lock.json $N/ && (cd $N && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error >&2) || { rm -rf $N; exit 75; }; fi; rm -rf node_modules && ln -s $N/node_modules node_modules || exit 75; rc=0; npx tsc --noEmit || rc=1; npx vitest run || rc=1; exit $rc

checks.name: storefront tsc + vitest (mac5)
command: export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; cd apps/storefront || exit 75; H=$(shasum -a 256 package-lock.json | cut -c1-12); N=/Volumes/FoundryBuild/fleet-dd/serenity-verify/apps-storefront-$H; if [ ! -d $N/node_modules ]; then rm -rf /Volumes/FoundryBuild/fleet-dd/serenity-verify/apps-storefront-*; mkdir -p $N && cp package.json package-lock.json $N/ && (cd $N && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error >&2) || { rm -rf $N; exit 75; }; fi; rm -rf node_modules && ln -s $N/node_modules node_modules || exit 75; rc=0; npx tsc --noEmit || rc=1; npx vitest run || rc=1; exit $rc

checks.name: ios unit tests
command: cp apps/ios/Config/Local.example.xcconfig apps/ios/Config/Local.xcconfig || exit 75; xcodebuild test -project apps/ios/SerenitySoother.xcodeproj -scheme SerenitySoother -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,id={simulator}' -only-testing:SerenitySootherTests -parallel-testing-enabled NO -derivedDataPath {derived_data} -skipMacroValidation -collect-test-diagnostics never CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual DEVELOPMENT_TEAM= PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER=

checks.name: training + prints unittest (mac5)
command: rc=0; /usr/bin/python3 -m unittest discover -s training/run1 -p 'test_*.py' || rc=1; /usr/bin/python3 -m unittest discover -s studio/print-config -p 'test_*.py' || rc=1; exit $rc
